name: smwgraphics-sanae-kochiya
title: Sanae Kochiya
description:
Player graphics of Sanae Kochiya from Touhou Project.

The Player 2 palette is Reimu Hakurei.
The fire palettes for each player are white haired "Mokou" Sanae and PC-98 Reimu respectively.

Includes the following files:
- GFX00.bin (Big player extra sprites)
- GFX10.bin (Map player)
- GFX22.bin (Small kiss blush)
- GFX24.bin (Big kiss blush)
- GFX28.bin (Hud text: "SANAE" & "REIMU")
- GFX32.bin (Player graphics)
- sanae_shared.pal (Shared player palette)

- yoshi_ow_fix.pal (Fix for Yoshi's overworld palette. To apply, import to every overworld submap using the Green Star + Red Arrow button in Lunar Magic)

Please note that the art style is not "smw styled", so it may not be entirely accurate to vanilla.


If you just want to play vanilla smw as Sanae, consider using this "Super Sanae World" bps patch instead. It has been patched to fix all text and adds other Sanae-related gfx changes (custom title screen & "The End" picture)
